luciole.title: Luciole
luciole.description: Conversational AI agent that automates tech intelligence: collects, analyzes and summarizes 200+ articles/day from 40+ RSS sources.
luciole.deliverables: ReAct agent with 8 tools, automated RSS ingestion pipeline, web interface with SSE streaming, custom RAG system, anti-injection security, Docker deployment
luciole.context: IT teams spend about 15 min per article on manual monitoring. This agent reduces that to seconds per query.

deliverables.title: ReAct conversational agent
deliverables.description: Reason → Act → Observe loop with intelligent routing to 7 tools (web search, RAG, SQL, audio transcription, vision, email digest). Model cascade gpt-4o-mini / gpt-4o based on detected complexity.

deliverables.title: Automated monitoring pipeline
deliverables.description: Daily collection of 38 RSS feeds, topic filtering, content scraping, parallelized LLM enrichment (5 threads), RAG indexing with chunking and embeddings. Runnable as one-shot or via APScheduler.

deliverables.title: Luciole web interface
deliverables.description: Jinja2 frontend with custom design system, SSE response streaming, JWT authentication with user accounts, persistent conversation history in SQLite, file upload (images, audio, PDF) with magic bytes validation.

deliverables.title: Custom hybrid RAG
deliverables.description: Numpy semantic search (cosine similarity on text-embedding-3-small) + BM25 lexical + freshness score + user feedback. HyDE query expansion and optional Cohere re-ranking. No external RAG framework.

decisions.title: Custom numpy RAG over LangChain/ChromaDB
decisions.description: Cosine similarity computed directly with numpy on JSON-stored embeddings. Eliminates external vector store dependency, reduces infra complexity and gives full control over hybrid scoring (semantic + BM25 + freshness + feedback).

decisions.title: Model cascade over a single model
decisions.description: A fast classifier (gpt-4o-mini) routes each query to the right model: gpt-4o-mini for greetings/FAQ, gpt-4o for complex reasoning. Reduces API costs on simple queries while maintaining quality on complex ones.

decisions.title: SSE streaming over classic request/response
decisions.description: Responses are streamed via Server-Sent Events with typed events (thinking, tool_result, chunk, done). Users see the selected tool and the response appearing in real time instead of waiting several seconds.

poei-mainframe-gestion-clientele.title: Mainframe customer manager
poei-mainframe-gestion-clientele.description: Banking customer management system built on mainframe z/OS in three stages: batch COBOL/JCL processing, DB2/SQL relational queries, and a real-time CICS transactional application.
poei-mainframe-gestion-clientele.deliverables: Batch and transactional COBOL programs, SQL scripts, BMS screens, compilation and execution JCL, VSAM files, full project report
poei-mainframe-gestion-clientele.context: Simulate the full cycle of a mainframe application around a single business domain — from batch processing to real-time transactional screens.

deliverables.title: Financial management system (COBOL main project)
deliverables.description: 21 progressive exercises covering a complete banking system: VSAM management (KSDS/ESDS/RRDS), subprograms CALL/CANCEL, SORT/MERGE, statement editing. 14 COBOL programs and 43 JCL.

deliverables.title: Multi-layer CICS transactional application
deliverables.description: Customer CRUD application with 3-layer architecture (Presentation/Processing/DAO): 7 BMS screens, 7 COBOL programs, transaction management and FSET/DATAONLY/CURSOR optimizations.

deliverables.title: DB2 main project — embedded SQL in COBOL
deliverables.description: 12 DB2 exercises with SQL queries (DDL/DML/advanced SELECT) and 10 COBOL-DB2 programs using cursors, SQLCA and embedded SQL to query and manipulate relational data.

deliverables.title: Structured course base (40,000+ lines)
deliverables.description: 64 Markdown files covering 7 domains (z/OS, TSO/ISPF, JCL, VSAM, COBOL, DB2, CICS, algorithms) serving as a complete technical reference for the training.

decisions.title: Why GnuCOBOL + Hercules over mainframe only
decisions.description: Dual environment: GnuCOBOL for fast local development (compilation in seconds), Hercules/TK4- to faithfully reproduce z/OS behavior (JCL, VSAM, ISPF). Enables fast iteration while validating on a realistic target.

decisions.title: Why a 3-layer architecture in CICS
decisions.description: Separation of Presentation (BMS/SEND MAP), Processing (business logic) and DAO (VSAM file access) into distinct programs. Reproduces mainframe industrial patterns and eases maintenance.

decisions.title: Why Markdown over PDF for course material
decisions.description: Native Git versioning, full-text search, readable diffs. The 64 files are organized by domain and chapter, making navigation and incremental updates easy.

tour-de-controle.title: Tour de Contrôle
tour-de-controle.description: Restaurant cash register and staff management web application, with transaction tracking and discrepancy detection.
tour-de-controle.deliverables: Swagger-documented REST API, full React interface, JWT authentication with RBAC, automatic cash discrepancy detection, staff CRUD, PostgreSQL with Sqitch migrations, Docker Compose 6 services
tour-de-controle.context: Addressing a real restaurant need: centralizing cash register and staff management into a single, reliable, and secure tool.

deliverables.title: Secured REST API
deliverables.description: Express.js/TypeScript API with JWT authentication via httpOnly cookies, rate limiting, Zod validation on all endpoints, and role-based access control.

deliverables.title: Cash register management interface
deliverables.description: React interface for opening/closing registers, entering transactions by payment type, and automatically calculating discrepancies between physical and theoretical amounts.

deliverables.title: Staff management
deliverables.description: Full user CRUD with role system (Developer, Manager, Supervisor, Waiter), password reset, and action logging in an action_logs table.

deliverables.title: Multi-service Docker infrastructure
deliverables.description: Docker Compose orchestrating 6 services: PostgreSQL, Sqitch (auto migrations), Node.js backend, React frontend, Swagger UI and pgAdmin.

decisions.title: Why httpOnly cookies over localStorage for JWT
decisions.description: Explicit migration from localStorage to httpOnly/Secure/SameSite cookies to eliminate token exfiltration risk via XSS. The token is no longer accessible client-side.

decisions.title: Why Sqitch over an ORM for migrations
decisions.description: Sqitch allows writing migrations in pure SQL with a deploy/revert/verify system, providing full control over the PostgreSQL schema without an abstraction layer.

decisions.title: Why Zod on both backend and frontend
decisions.description: Zod is used on both sides to validate inputs with the same rules (email, complex password, French phone number), ensuring full-stack validation consistency.

decisions.title: Why LazyMotion over the full Framer Motion bundle
decisions.description: Loading domAnimation only on demand to reduce initial JavaScript, combined with per-route code splitting via React.lazy.

site-vitrine-avocate.title: Rayssa Harmes Lawyer
site-vitrine-avocate.description: Professional showcase website for a Strasbourg-based lawyer, optimized for local SEO and converting visitors into booked appointments.
site-vitrine-avocate.deliverables: 13-page site, Formspree contact form, Calendly booking, local SEO with JSON-LD, responsive design, GDPR compliance, full test suite
site-vitrine-avocate.context: A practicing lawyer in Strasbourg needed a professional website to rank on local searches and make it easy for clients to book consultations.

deliverables.title: SEO-optimized multi-page showcase site
deliverables.description: 13 static pages with App Router (home, 5 legal practice areas, about, testimonials, fees, contact, legal notices, privacy policy). JSON-LD structured data of type LegalService for local search ranking.

deliverables.title: Accessible contact form system
deliverables.description: Multi-field form with client-side validation, Formspree integration, reusable components (FormInput, FormSelect, FormTextarea, FormCheckbox) and WCAG 2.1 AA compliance verified by axe-core tests.

deliverables.title: Automated testing pipeline
deliverables.description: 9 unit/accessibility tests (Vitest + Testing Library + jest-axe) and 3 E2E suites (Playwright) covering navigation, pages and the contact form. Pre-commit hooks via Husky + lint-staged.

deliverables.title: Calendly integration for appointment booking
deliverables.description: Embedded booking widget allowing clients to schedule appointments directly from the site without additional friction.

decisions.title: Next.js App Router over a headless CMS
decisions.description: Content is stable (legal pages rarely change). The App Router enables native static rendering, per-route metadata and structured data without the complexity of an external CMS.

decisions.title: Vitest + Playwright over Jest alone
decisions.description: Vitest offers native compatibility with Vite tooling and faster execution. Playwright covers critical paths (navigation, form submission) on real browsers.

decisions.title: Cookie-free analytics (Vercel Analytics) over Google Analytics
decisions.description: GDPR compliance without a consent banner: Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights don't set third-party cookies, eliminating the need for a CMP.
